title: solidago graminifolia var. media
intro: Solidago graminifolia var. media, commonly known as Stiff Goldenrod, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Stiff Goldenrod include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a useful remedy for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
